releases.title: 版本更新
content: 新增：代码块头部工具栏新增自动换行切换按钮，与设置中的代码块自动换行开关同步；开启后代码自动折行显示、行号列自动隐藏，关闭时保持整行横向滚动
新增：代码语言选择菜单支持键盘导航，方向键循环选择、回车快速选中，鼠标悬停与键盘高亮一致，高亮项超出可视区时列表自动滚动定位
优化：文件侧栏不再依赖固定工作区目录，始终跟随当前打开的文档，打开或切换文档时自动刷新为文档所在目录的同级文件
优化：斜杠菜单在代码块与行内代码中不再触发，输入斜杠作为代码内容时不会误弹面板，不影响写代码
优化：斜杠菜单只在真正插入内容（输入、粘贴）时弹出，删除、换行、合并行等操作后光标停在斜杠命令后也不会再次弹出
优化：AI 动作条不再在代码块内弹出，选中代码块文本时不会出现润色、重写等对代码无意义的操作
优化：点击「添加到选取」后 AI 动作条立即隐藏，同一段选区不再反复弹出遮挡正文，重新选择其他文本后恢复显示
修复：斜杠菜单没有匹配命令时回车键不再被吞掉，会正常换行并关闭面板；空状态提示同步改为按 Esc 或 Enter 关闭
新增：光标位于标题开头时输入 # 可将标题升级一级（例如一级标题变为二级标题），与 Typora 的标题级别调整方式一致
优化：光标位于标题开头时按退格键不再把整个标题删除并并入上一行，而是让标题降级一级，一级标题直接转为普通段落
contentEn: Added a wrap toggle to the code block header toolbar, synced with the code block wrapping setting; wrapping hides line numbers, while off keeps horizontal scrolling.
The code language menu supports keyboard navigation: arrow keys cycle, Enter selects, hover and keyboard highlights match, and the list scrolls to the highlighted item.
The file sidebar no longer depends on a fixed workspace folder; it follows the currently open document and refreshes to that folder's files when opening or switching documents.
The slash menu no longer triggers inside code blocks or inline code, so typing a slash as code content does not pop up the panel.
The slash menu appears only when content is actually inserted (typing, paste); deleting, line breaks, and line merges do not reopen it after the caret rests after a slash command.
The AI action bar no longer appears inside code blocks; selecting code text does not offer polish or rewrite actions that make no sense for code.
After clicking Add to selection the AI action bar hides immediately, avoiding repeated obstruction; selecting other text shows it again.
When no command matches, Enter is no longer swallowed: it inserts a line break and closes the panel; the empty-state hint now says close with Esc or Enter.
Typing # at the start of a heading promotes it one level (for example, H1 becomes H2), matching Typora's heading level behavior.
Backspace at the start of a heading no longer deletes the whole heading into the previous line; it demotes the heading, and H1 becomes a normal paragraph.

linux.requirements: 主流 64 位 Linux 发行版
